title: C. W. Swain Building, 120 North High Street, Muncie, Delaware County, IN
notes: Significance: The C.W. Swain Building, a commercial/apartment block, was built on Muncie's Courthouse Square in 1896.  It is a typical example of commercial architecture in the Mid-West at the turn of the century, of interest due to a recent restoration.
